review: 701.70a-1: the library order was implicit; setup notes now state that Forest is the top card.

scenarios.title: Recruit draws, discards, and makes a Human Soldier only if the discard was a nonland card

setup.notes: A's library is listed top first: Forest is the top card.

decisions: A casts Esgaroth Garrison, tapping all five Plains.
Both players pass; the creature resolves and its enter trigger (recruit) goes on the stack. Both players pass.
On resolution A draws Forest from the top of the library, then discards Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: discard_nonland
variants.expected: A drew Forest and discarded Grizzly Bears (in A's graveyard). A 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token is created; Esgaroth Garrison's power is 2.

variants.label: discard_land
variants.delta: A discards the drawn Forest instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Forest is in A's graveyard and Grizzly Bears stays in A's hand. No token is created; Esgaroth Garrison's power is 1.
